description: YAML anchors (`&name`), aliases (`*name`), and type tags (`!!str`, `!!int`) are out of scope for Core 1.0 (Appendix A) — the scanner has no special handling for `&`, `*`, or `!!` sigils, so each remains part of an ordinary unquoted string value. Behavior is identical in strict mode (verified separately; these forms never match any strict-error-list condition, the same reasoning as core.document.unrecognized-line.skipped-both-modes for other out-of-grammar constructs).
